rule: Ads appear only in the places listed here (an allow-list, never a block-list). Ads are matched to the screen's subject, never to the person; always labelled in the reader's language; capped; never in the never list; off per country until legal sign-off; never on a product's paid tier; never in a household workspace or anywhere a child is the audience. An ad never delays a screen: it comes from the device's cached bundle, draws after the screen is ready, and a missing ad leaves no gap. Only impressions that were really seen count, devices never bill, and advertisers see totals only. Prices, shares and every revenue figure here are placeholders and assumptions until the first advertisers sign.

The till's idle screen between sales
After the sale is finished and the receipt is out

categories.age_sensitive_rule: Accepted only where the country pack lists the category in allowed_ad_categories, and never for a child audience or in a school or household workspace.
categories.regulated_rule: Accepted only from an advertiser licensed in every target country (proof kept by the Partner Hub).

viewability.rule: An impression counts only when at least half the ad was on screen for at least a second, reported once, sealed by the device; clicks and redemptions count only after a counted impression.

ranking: price times relevance: an ad whose contexts match the screen's subject ranks twice as high, so useful offers win over loud ones
merchant_controls: host or not host ads on each place the merchant owns
block an advertiser or a competitor's brand
go ad-free with any paid tier

revenue.what: Labelled ads in the places above, priced by auction with a country floor
Suppliers promote their products to shops at reorder time; paid per click or per confirmed order
Small businesses promote their own shop or offer on Explore and search from a small daily budget

Sponsored stays, trips and events for Free Pass members

LynkOmni plans and runs campaigns for larger advertisers for a service fee; creative drafts by LynkAssist, approved by a person
Advertisers and agencies manage campaigns and read totals through LynkDev
Every paid tier removes ads, so ads also lift upgrades

seamless: the ad is chosen from the device's cached bundle; no network call while a screen draws
an ad draws after the screen is ready and never moves anything already on it
a failed or missing ad leaves no gap and no message
no autoplay, sound, animation or pop-up; reduced motion and lite mode respected
text and design tokens only; translated into every language through the safe translation path
the sale, payment and every task always take the screen back at once
